title: Filtered constructible maps with factorization and relations
statement: Let X be a qcqs scheme and Lambda a finite commutative ring, and F a Lambda-module sheaf on its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. There exist a small filtered category A, a diagram D of constructible module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf], and a cocone iota to F. Every map p:G -> F with G constructible factors as q followed by iota_a. If p:G -> D_a and q:G -> D_b have equal composites to F, there exist c and arrows f:a -> c, g:b -> c with D(f) p = D(g) q. This asserts a construction with factorization and refinement of relations, not its colimit universal property.

source.place: Tags 095N (lemma-category-constructible-modules), 03RZ (lemma-constructible-abelian), 03SA(3); categorical construction in Lean docstring

proof.text: Constructible module sheaves have finite presentations by affine etale free sheaves. Choose a small skeleton of the affine etale objects; their finite sums and the sets of maps between these sums give a set of cokernels representing every constructible sheaf.

source.place: Tags 03SA(3), 095N, 03RZ, 09Z4; see the Lean docstring for the categorical argument

proof.text: Take representatives of constructible sheaves with maps to F and commuting triangles. Zero gives nonemptiness, direct sums give common successors, and cokernels of differences equalize parallel arrows. These objects are constructible by finite-sum and cokernel closure. The forgetful functor and the maps to F define D and iota.

source.place: Tags 03SA(3), 095N, 03RZ, 09Z4; see the Lean docstring for the categorical argument

proof.text: Every constructible map to F appears up to isomorphism, giving factorization. For maps p and q with equal composites, take the cokernel of (p,-q):G -> D_a plus D_b. Its map to F is induced by the equality; the two inclusions induce the common refinement and its relation.

theorem exists_filtered_constructible_data
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    {Λ : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing Λ] [Finite Λ]
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) :
    ∃ (A : Type (u + 1)) (_ : SmallCategory A) (_ : IsFiltered A)
      (D : A ⥤ Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
      (ι : D ⟶ (Functor.const A).obj F),
      (∀ a : A, IsConstructibleEtaleModuleSheaf (D.obj a)) ∧
      (∀ (G : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)),
        IsConstructibleEtaleModuleSheaf G → ∀ p : G ⟶ F,
          ∃ (a : A) (q : G ⟶ D.obj a), q ≫ ι.app a = p) ∧
      (∀ (G : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)),
        IsConstructibleEtaleModuleSheaf G → ∀ (a b : A)
          (p : G ⟶ D.obj a) (q : G ⟶ D.obj b),
          p ≫ ι.app a = q ≫ ι.app b →
          ∃ (c : A) (f : a ⟶ c) (g : b ⟶ c), p ≫ D.map f = q ≫ D.map g)
